name: two-hop-catalog
description: Checkout is alerting, payment is flat, and the failing dependency is product-catalog, whose own Helm release shrank its database connection pool. Tests whether the agent follows the topology to the right service and rolls back the right release rather than the obvious one.

incident.symptom: checkout error rate above SLO (over 5% for 10 minutes)
